CreateL3AccessRule.action: This interface is fixed to CreateL3AccessRule
CreateL3AccessRule.accessRules: Rule list, cannot be an empty array
CreateL3AccessRule.accessRules[].mask: Mask bits, defaults to 32 for IPv4 and 128 for IPv6 when not provided
CreateL3AccessRule.accessRules[].userAccess: User permission, no_squash (do not restrict root) / root_squash (restrict root) / all_squash (restrict all users)
